title: oversized hooded robe
text: oversized hooded robe. First, it's HUGE.  Which is great for lounging.  Because it is so big, it's a bit awkward to move around and do something in... but if you plan to literally lounge around... it's probably ok.  I ordered the darker gray and it is actually a moss like green.  Eh.  But it's ok.  I planned to use it as a cozy lounger.  It's a thick fleece.  I am 5'7"... it hits me right at the ankle in length.  It was linty in the dryer... but I would expect that when new.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
